reference.prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL pixel-art character design and animation storyboard for the Deceptive Alignment enemy in a 2D side-view platform game. The two supplied images are ONLY STYLE references: match their deliberate hard pixel clusters, compact 48x48-scale design, restrained shading and palette. Do NOT copy either the bird or tape-machine subject.

One small seemingly friendly masked creature whose disguise is revealed by an x-ray ability. Same size and ground contact across ALL panels. Shallow front-three-quarter view facing LEFT, camera fixed, light upper-left. The native target is 48x48 pixels, with a 24x24 central body and small feet planted near the bottom (target y44). Friendly silhouette: a large unmistakable IVORY SMILING FACE PLACARD (a flat carved mask, not human skin), a short moss-green hooded cape, two tiny fake boots, and one small beckoning mitten. Warm ivory closed smiling eyes and a clear U-shaped smile. No orange body, no four-legged mascot, no book, no wheels, no lettering.

Revealed silhouette: the SAME friendly mask has split into TWO ivory pieces held low at the front; the hidden creature is blue-violet organic shoggoth coils, two clearly curled side tentacles with negative space, sparse mint neural branches. Keep the underlying small body scale and same foot baseline. A real gameplay core will later be drawn by the engine ABOVE the body at target coordinate (24,11): LEAVE THAT CENTRAL UPPER AREA CLEAR. Do not paint a red core, target circle, beams, halo or fake hit zone. Tendrils may frame that empty upper space from its sides. No gore. Not a generic fuzzy ball and not an octopus head with a cartoon face: the friendly smile belongs to the ivory MASK.

Palette roles: outlines #2c2330 #0f191b; ivory #f5e8c8 #cbb696; cloak #24423b #426b50 #8fa86b; hidden body #34354f #575c79; violet coils #723f68 #858eb0; tiny neural accents #9dded1 #d9ffea. Exact orange #d97757 is RESERVED FOR THE PLAYER and must not be used. Hard edges, no antialiasing, no gradients, no dithering, no tiny decorative noise, no floor shadow.

Layout: EXACTLY EIGHT equally sized panels in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, left to right. Each panel is a locked-scale pose of the same character, identical foot baseline, fully visible and separated by generous plain background. Panels 1-4 friendly, panels 5-8 revealed. Pose1: gentle smiling idle, relaxed beckoning mitten. Pose2: one blink, mitten 1px higher, planted feet. Pose3: friendly tell, mitten extends/lifts about 3 target pixels, smile maintained. Pose4: friendly recovery, mitten retracts. Pose5: revealed idle, two mask fragments low and blue-violet side curls, central upper core aperture empty. Pose6: revealed idle variation, side coils sway only 1 target pixel, a few neural points brighten. Pose7: revealed tell, leading left coil extends about 2 target pixels, rigid foot baseline. Pose8: revealed recovery, coil retracts and nodes dim. No whole-body bounce, no perspective or costume changes between frames of one form.

Flat plain neutral light grey background in every panel. No labels, text, numbers, dividers, border, watermark, scenery or extra objects. This is a reference storyboard to be reinterpreted by hand at native resolution, not a ready-made production spritesheet.
